description: Human-agent squad collaboration pack: task-tag claiming (make task), isolated Git feature branches (feature/<TICKET-ID>-<slug>), and upward PR delivery

recommended_surface_bindings.description: Task-tag branch isolation, WORKTASK.md / SESSION.md synchronization, and 1-hop PR escalation
invariants: Claim tasks via make task TASK=<id> (layer-config.sh start-task) before editing domain or code files
Isolate work on a dedicated feature/<TICKET-ID>-<slug> branch mapped 1:1 to a WORKTASK.md item
Escalate cross-squad or department policy changes upward via make promote (--create-pr)
